en.headline: Experts say high-strength concrete can fix defective columns at Tung Chung West station
en.dek: Engineering lawmaker Aaron Bok says non-shrink grout can fill gaps in about 30 columns where concrete failed to reach the ceiling, calling the work a basic mistake.
body: Engineering sector lawmaker Aaron Bok Kwok-ming said the contractor could fill gaps in about 30 defective columns at the Tung Chung West MTR station under construction with higher-strength concrete such as non-shrink grout to restore structural support.

An engineer and a construction sector leader described the work as a basic mistake and criticised the contractor for poor oversight and for failing to record and report the defects before carrying out repairs.

The Buildings Department said on Saturday that about 30 columns were defective because the concrete had failed to reach the upper ceiling, leaving steel reinforcement bars exposed. Temporary supports for the floor slab remain in place, and officials have said there is no immediate structural risk.
The MTR Corporation ordered a halt to related works after discovering unauthorised remedial activity. The department has asked for an investigation report and proposed remedial measures.

zh.headline: 專家稱高強度混凝土可修復東涌西站欠妥支柱
zh.dek: 工程界議員卜國明指可用無收縮灌漿填充約30條支柱缺口，混凝土未灌至天花屬基本失誤。
body: 工程界立法會議員卜國明表示，承建商可用較高強度混凝土，例如無收縮灌漿，填充東涌西站約30條欠妥支柱的缺口，以恢復結構支撑。
一名工程師及建造業界領袖形容有關工序屬基本失誤，並批評承建商監管不力，在進行修復前未有記錄及報告缺陷。
屋宇署周六指，約30條支柱因混凝土未能灌至天花而欠妥，鋼筋外露。樓板臨時支撑仍在，當局指暫無即時結構風險。
港鐵公司在發現未經授權的修復工作後，已下令暫停相關工程。屋宇署已要求提交調查報告及擬議補救措施。
